description: Source code for a React Native native module (RCTNNativeModule) handling Android-specific functionalities such as shortcuts, widget updates, app state, and UI modifications within the Notesnook app.

classes.name: RCTNNativeModule
classes.description: React Native module providing Android-specific functionalities such as shortcuts, widget updates, app state management, and UI modifications for the Notesnook app.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the current activity's window.

methods.name: getActivityName
methods.description: Retrieves the simple name of the current activity.

methods.name: setSecureMode
methods.description: Enables or disables secure mode (flags the window to prevent screenshots).

methods.name: setAppState
methods.description: Stores the app state string in shared preferences.

methods.name: getAppState
methods.description: Retrieves the stored app state string from shared preferences.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Returns the widget ID from NotePreviewConfigureActivity.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Stores a string value in shared preferences under a specified store name and key.

methods.name: removeString
methods.description: Removes a string value from shared preferences.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from shared preferences.

methods.name: saveAndFinish
methods.description: Calls a method to save state and finish the activity.

methods.name: getIntent
methods.description: Returns a map of intent extras related to reminders and notes.

methods.name: cancelAndFinish
methods.description: Cancels the activity and finishes it.

methods.name: getWidgetNotes
methods.description: Retrieves list of note IDs stored in shared preferences.

methods.name: hasWidgetNote
methods.description: Checks if a note ID exists in widget data.

methods.name: updateWidgetNote
methods.description: Updates widget data for a specific note ID.

methods.name: updateReminderWidget
methods.description: Triggers update for reminder widgets.

methods.name: isGestureNavigationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if gesture navigation is enabled on Android Q+.

methods.name: addShortcut
methods.description: Creates and requests a pinned shortcut with specified parameters.

methods.name: removeShortcut
methods.description: Disables a shortcut by ID.

methods.name: updateShortcut
methods.description: Updates an existing shortcut with new details.

methods.name: removeAllShortcuts
methods.description: Removes all pinned shortcuts.

methods.name: getAllShortcuts
methods.description: Retrieves all pinned shortcuts and their details.

methods.name: createLetterIcon
methods.description: Creates an icon bitmap with a letter or color circle based on type.

methods.name: getColorForLetter
methods.description: Returns a color based on the hash of a letter.
